name: Farana
description: Farana was a Wild Space planet where at one point the pirate Hondo Ohnaka acquired the frigate Acushnet and several Flarestar-class attack shuttles from a collector of antiquities. The planet was home to a type of aggressive creature, which the human Mosey Cimmaron and their sister hunted at some point by 9 BBY.
